title: Prepare core for susi-harness to leave: keep channel_bindings in core and forward harness callers
goal: Vision: V-9. Core half of relocating susi-harness (35,259 runtime lines) to susi-commercial-apps (commercial T-CORESIZEVAULT-21; decisions 2470, 2506). (1) The installed channel (src/installed_channel/transaction.rs, host_task.rs) uses susi_harness::channel_bindings (windows_root, register, notification_complete, verify): move that module into a core crate that stays (susi-paths or the installed channel itself). (2) Route every other caller (src/cli/harness_cli.rs, susi-daemon harness_ops, crown and composition, src/cli/acp_mcp.rs, os_cli, catalog_plane_cli, susi-gmcp harness_tools, susi-cli-defs harness) through forwarding to susi-commercial harness verbs or plane-bus topics served by the plug host, an installation without it naming the command. (3) After commercial's copy passes side by side on Windows and Linux, delete crates/susi-harness and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING.

reuse.searched: The forwarding pattern of the vault move (crates/susi-config/src/vault_exec.rs run_commercial, commercial_executable) and the plug-host bus topics; core's own channel_bindings module (moved, not rewritten).

limitations: No scope is lent over the plane bus (board 2588, replacing 2552): core's plane_bus req keeps gawd.*, gemi.*, tools.* and agents.* in-process for a scoped session, so any harness path inside that scoped chain (ACP session handling in src/cli/acp_mcp.rs, the mission engine, tool execution) moves as one unit with it, or the moved code returns tool_calls to its caller as GEMI does. Calls on other topics (for example ecosystem_hub.*) reach the plug host with or without a scope. Pillar code: Linux pass before the deletion (SusiCoreSizeVault, board 2549).
progress: (1) done: channel_bindings (962 lines) moved from crates/susi-harness into the core library (src/channel_bindings.rs, #[doc(hidden)]), installed channel and entry test re-pointed; count unchanged. (2) and (3) not started.
